profile.headline: Business Analyst & Advisor, Personal Coach, Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Eric is a full stack developer. He is a natural business analyst with a strong technical background. Eric has specialized in .NET technology working on the entire scope of Microsoft Solutions and Application Environments. He has an extraordinary aptitude in analyzing business requirements in one-on-one and meetings with customers in guiding successful solutions.  He is an excellent and detailed problem solver, with an eye for new features and enhancements. He has an aptitude toward visualizing scalability and complexity in application architecture.

AspNet Core, JQuery, Bootstrap, SQL.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Eric has 20+ years of .NET technology stack experience working on the entire scope of the development stack for Microsoft Solutions and Application Environments.  He easily acquires new platform elements in Client-Side UI technologies, and Server-Side models, and backend enterprise frameworks and architectures. He has an extraordinary aptitude in analyzing business requirements working directly with customers to guide successful solutions.  He is a proponent of a software development eco-system that implements the principles of Continuous Integration and QA testing in a continuous deployment pipeline from business analysis to development and delivery.  He is also an excellent and detailed problem solver with an eye to rapid bug resolution and insight into root cause discovery.  He is a significant contributor to business process enhancement by suggesting new features and methodologies for process integration.  He has an aptitude toward visualizing scalability and complexity that is leveraged to deliver robust and efficient application service architectures.  He enjoys data analysis utilizing large data sets and business intelligence. He has an intrinsic passion for performance and algorithmic efficiency.
